feeds.title: Wilderness Scotland Blog
feeds.description: Wilderness Scotland is a specialist adventure travel company offering a range of inspiring adventures in the most remote and beautiful regions. Top-rated & widest range of guided & self-guided walking, & sea kayaking. This blog is full of articles to educate, entertain and inspire our adventure-loving community.

feeds.title: Southern Utah Wilderness Alliance
feeds.description: SUWA is the only non-partisan, non-profit organization working full time to defend Utah's red rock wilderness. Find out more about wilderness by following this blog.

feeds.title: Quetico Superior Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The mission of the Quetico Superior Foundation is the protection of the wilderness character of Minnesota's Border Lakes Canoe Country and Ontario's Quetico Provincial Park. Follow to get updates on wilderness news.

feeds.title: Living Wilderness
feeds.description: Kevin Ebi is a professional nature photographer whose work has appeared in numerous publications, including National Geographic, National Wildlife, Smithsonian,and Outdoor Photographer. Follow this blog for thoughts on nature photography and environmental conservation.

feeds.title: Trail Memoirs Blog
feeds.description: Trail Memoirs Blog tells you about the beauty of wild freedom, earth's wilderness, and ever-changing landscape. Follow for the latest buzz, journal excerpts, and inspiration!

feeds.title: Northeast Wilderness Trust
feeds.description: The Northeast Wilderness Trust works to conserve forever-wild landscapes for nature and people. As the only land trust in the Northeast dedicated exclusively to protecting the land as wilderness, the organization uses variousland conservation tools and often works with conservation partners including other land trusts. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Wilderness England Blog
feeds.description: The blog is full of articles to educate, entertain and inspire adventure-loving communities, featuring a top-rated range of guided & self-guided walking, road cycling, self-drive, and private travel adventure holidays in England. Wilderness England's mission is to provide inspiring, memorable, and high-quality adventure travel experiences, which benefit the local environments and communities.

feeds.title: Wilderness Dweller
feeds.description: I am a wilderness dweller. I live off the grid, alone, and have done so for over 30 years. Find out more articles about wilderness by following this feed.

feeds.title: Wilderness Workshop
feeds.description: The Wilderness Workshop is the conservation watchdog of nearly 4 million acres of public lands in western Colorado.Using science, the law and grassroots activism, WW works to keep the White River National Forest and nearby BLM lands more or less as it is. Signup to receive email updates from Wilderness Workshop.

feeds.title: Wilderness Ireland Blog
feeds.description: The Wilderness Ireland Blog is the place to grab a cuppa and be inspired by some of the adventures, great imagery and useful info the team has to share. Follow to get regular updates from this blog in your inbox.

feeds.title: Wilderness of Waves Blog
feeds.description: The Wilderness of Waves is a blog by a solosailor, filmmaker & artist Olivia O Wyatt. She is sailing her 34 ft. boat, Juniper, to destinations guided by humpback whale migration patterns. Follow along as she wanders the seas in search of magic.

feeds.title: Africa Wilderness Safaris
feeds.description: Explore Africa's wildlife with Gorilla Safaris, South Africa Tours, Victoria falls, chimpanzee, to desert expeditions in Namibia and African sandy beaches. Follow this blog for regular updates.

feeds.title: California Wilderness Coalition
feeds.description: The California Wilderness Coalition (CalWild) protects and restores the state's wildest natural landscapes and watersheds on public lands. These important wild places provide clean air and water, refuges for wildlife, mitigation against the effects of climate change, and outstanding opportunities for recreation and spiritual renewal for people.

feeds.title: Active Life Company
feeds.description: Articles in the Wilderness & Wildlife Blog are intended to educate our readers about topics related to the outdoors: conservation and wildlife, outside adventures, gear reviews, outdoor athletes, camp cooking recipes, outdoor sports, and tips to make your adventures better.

feeds.title: Wilderness Need
feeds.description: Our advocacy is to explore less-visited wilderness areas and post credible information so others can visit with maximum enjoyment and minimal impact. To share observations and commentary to make the case for more visitor-friendly management of wilderness. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Tennessee Citizens for Wilderness Planning Blog
feeds.description: TCWP is dedicated to protecting natural lands and waters by means of public ownership, legislation, or cooperation of the private sector. Our efforts focus on the Cumberland and Appalachian regions of East Tennessee but may extend to the rest of the state and the nation.

feeds.title: CPAWS Northern Alberta Blog
feeds.description: Canadian Parks & Wilderness Society (CPAWS) of Northern Alberta is a non-profit community-based citizen voice for maintaining wilderness and biodiversity. This blog contains CPAWS action and alerts, communications regarding our conservation campaigns and general CPAWS news updates.

feeds.title: Great Old Broads for Wilderness
feeds.description: Great Old Broads for Wilderness is a national grassroots organization, led by women, that engages and inspires activism to preserve and protect wilderness and wildlands. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Wilderness Volunteers Blog
feeds.description: Our Mission is the stewardship of America's wildlands through organizing and promoting volunteer service in cooperation with public land agencies including the national park service, the forest service, the bureau of land management and our fish and wildlife service. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Open Sky Wilderness Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Open Sky assists teens, young adults, and families struggling with difficult challenges and life circumstances, emphasizing treatment for the whole family. Follow the Open Sky blog to catch up on news, learn about our programming, and get to know our clinical team's therapeutic approach.

feeds.title: Women and the Wilderness Blog
feeds.description: Planning a hike or a road trip soon? Perhaps you're looking to adopt more mindful practices or begin your journey through yoga. On the Women & the Wilderness blog you will find everything from destination guides, road trip highlights, travel tips and resources for living and traveling more sustainably.

feeds.title: Signs in the Wilderness
feeds.description: Signs in the Wilderness is a blog that includes the ways in which the ancestors used to save the wilderness. Follow this blog to get more updates.

feeds.title: Micro Wilderness Blog
feeds.description: Micro Wilderness is dedicated to providing the best exotic animals, especially Tarantulas, to the fan community. Follow to get regular updates from this blog in your inbox.

feeds.title: Wilderness Louisville
feeds.description: Wilderness Louisville is a nonprofit organization founded in 2013 with a mission to be champions for Louisville's natural areas, from Jefferson Memorial Forest, the nation's largest municipally-owned urban forest, to the ones in your neighborhood. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Wilderness Medical Training
feeds.description: Wilderness Medical Training is the leading expert in the provision of medical training for overseas travelers and expedition medics. Subscribe to get articles from this blog in your inbox.

feeds.title: Advanced Wilderness Life Support
feeds.description: The Advanced Wilderness Life Support certification course has grown significantly since its development at the University of Utah School of Medicine in 1997. This blog is designed for professional and non-medical individuals who need knowledge to combat dire situations in nature.

feeds.title: True North Wilderness Blog
feeds.description: We began our careers as field guides for a well-known therapeutic wilderness program almost 20 years ago, and our passion for working with struggling teens in the outdoors was born. Blog cover topics such as the clinical implication of wilderness, common clinical themes, research and more.

feeds.title: The Chilko Experience Wilderness Resort
feeds.description: Sustainable living in this environment can be challenging. Chilko Experience tries to minimize our environmental footprint and still offer guests the best experience possible. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Blue Ridge Therapeutic Wilderness Blog
feeds.description: Blue Ridge is known for offering the highest level of clinically integrated and individualized programming by employing dynamic therapists and tenured field staff who are known for their contribution to wilderness therapy. Follow for more updates.
